summary: Iter 623 (Paket 26 - unified pricing / RMS+LOS on /book, room detail modal, member rate, taxes, site translations/posts/analytics/brand, sitemap/robots, contact honeypot+rate-limit). Wrote pytest test_iter623_paket26.py with 17 tests: 16 PASS, 1 SKIP (widget /api/booking-widget/{pid}/search endpoint returned nothing comparable — could not cross-verify totals). Frontend: /book?property=aldgate-flats&lang=tr — price-explain-<rid> present (x5), room-detail-btn opens room-detail-modal with room-detail-explanation, member-rate-bar → gold@test.com check applied '%10 indirim' banner and 5 member-rate lines with plan totals lowered ~10% (£236→£212). extra-bed dropdown visible with '+£15/gece'. /site/aldgate-flats — site-lang-select works, URL gains ?lang=en, hreflang tags present [tr,en,de,x-default], nav labels English, site-nav-blog opens Blog & Offers with 2 posts (Yaz Kampanyası %20 slug 'yaz-kampanyasi-20'), site-contact-hp honeypot input present, cookie-accept sets document.documentElement.dataset.mhbAnalytics='ga4,gtm,pixel' and injects googletagmanager script (mhb-ga4-src). site-room-detail-<rid> navigates to /site/aldgate-flats/rooms/<rid>?lang=en, site-room-detail-title & site-room-detail-book render, site-room-back returns to rooms list. Backend /api/site-builder/public/analytics returns ga4/gtm/pixel + brand accent #b45309. Sitemap XML contains /site/, /rooms/<id>, /blog/<slug> plus hreflang alternates. Robots.txt contains Sitemap:. Contact honeypot returns id 'spam-ignored' without persisting inquiry; rate limit returns 429 on 6th rapid post (backend allows 5/hour).

minor.issue: Widget cross-verification skipped — endpoint either not present as /search or returns shape without rooms[].stay_total, so unified-pricing parity could not be programmatically asserted. Data-level comparison via /api/booking/rooms nightly totals matches expectations (RMS-driven), but a definitive widget-vs-book endpoint parity test could not be executed.

ui_bugs.issue: content.brand.accent (#b45309) is NOT applied to hero/CTA. site-book-cta computed backgroundColor is rgb(15,76,92) (coastal default) instead of rgb(180,83,9). CSS var --mhb-accent evaluates empty. Backend saves accent correctly (GET /public/analytics returns brand.accent='#b45309'); frontend theme layer isn't reading it.

content.translations.en.headline='A calm escape' is NOT applied — hero H1 still shows property name 'Aldgate Flats' when lang=en. Some other translation-controlled strings ('gece'den', 'ODALARIMIZ') also stay Turkish under EN. Backend GET /public/site returns translations correctly; frontend translation resolver isn't wired to override the coastal template hero headline.

issues: Hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (language/currency selector) — unchanged from iter 620.

action_items: FIX FRONTEND (HotelSitePage.js / site theme): apply content.brand.accent as a CSS custom property (e.g. document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--mhb-accent', accent)) and use it in the primary Book/CTA button & nav pill so rgb(180,83,9) actually renders. Same for brand.radius on rounded elements.

FIX FRONTEND translations: when lang=en/de and content.translations[lang].headline is set, override the coastal template hero headline (currently hard-coded to property.name). Similar override should cover about text and other translatable content strings.

OPTIONAL: expose GET /api/booking-widget/{pid}/search (or document the correct path) so unified-pricing parity between /widget and /book can be programmatically asserted; today only shape parity is verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Unified pricing in bookings.get_booking_rooms is correctly delegating to widget_pricing.nightly_rates + explain_price + check_los_restrictions — parity guaranteed at code-path level even if I couldn't hit the widget /search endpoint.

be_conversion.reserve_multi applies member discount only to nightly (correctly excludes taxes/extra-bed/child). Tax breakdown correct: vat included, city_tax = per-night * nights * rooms. Manage URL prefix /guest-portal-v2?ref=... correct.

site_builder.public_contact: rate-limit is 5/hour (>=5 hits → 429). Spec said '6th returns 429' — matches since first 5 succeed. Honeypot returns 200 with id 'spam-ignored' and does NOT touch site_inquiries or notifications — good.
site_builder.save_site strips invalid brand.accent (non #RRGGBB) — verified 'red' is dropped. Translations sanitized per allowed keys. Post slug slugified correctly ('yaz-kampanyasi-20').
Sitemap XML includes hreflang alternates only for translations present + tr — correct.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (2 issues: brand accent + translations headline not applied)

rca_of_the_issue: Frontend: HotelSitePage renders coastal template with hardcoded property.name in hero and hardcoded template accent variables. It reads content.translations[lang] and content.brand from public/site payload but does not actually inject brand.accent into the CSS variable pipeline or substitute translations[lang].headline into the hero H1. Backend layer is fully correct.
